page.overview:
Who is Darth Adacia?

Darth Adacia was an individual affiliated with the Sith. They claimed that a weakened enemy was a defeated enemy.

Darth Adacia was created for Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught, a 2019 expansion to the 2011 BioWare video game Star Wars: The Old Republic. In the game, they are mentioned in the description for the "Spiteful Saber" Tactical item as the author of a quote provided in it.
